summary: byNordic Acquisition Corp, a blank-check SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting it deposited $17,470 into its trust account to extend the deadline for completing an initial business combination from July 12, 2026 to August 12, 2026. This is a routine monthly extension under a previously approved charter amendment, not a new special situation event. The filing contains no merger agreement, de-SPAC announcement, or definitive transaction. Absent a target or material change, this extension filing does not qualify as a special situation under the defined categories.
